text:
Dana M: Heads up 7 Lina (contractor) is starting Tue remote in AZ. Background check returned "address unverified" because she used a passport + hotel confirmation. She asked if we can accept passport for I-9 Section 2 since she has no state ID yet.
Omar H: For I-9 you can use List A docs like passport, that covers both identity and employment authorization. Must be the original passport. If she can't present in person, we do authorized rep option but rep must inspect the original.
Ivy P: She's out of town until Monday afternoon. Could we use a local notary for Section 2 then we reimburse? Also asks whether badge can be mailed or she needs to pick up.
Kevin B: We can mail a temporary badge and laptop if shipping is set. IT said they can ship the MacBook with the 2-factor token package; ops just needs to confirm shipping address and that we add "hold for ID verification" label.
Dana M: I'll ask Lina to confirm she'll present passport to a nearby UPS notary or to our rep. Also will ask for the hotel invoice that Checkr flagged.
Omar H: Note: if using a notary we need candidate to sign the authorized rep form and the notary must note their commission. Save the signed rep form in the secure HR folder.
Ivy P: Can we avoid in-person altogether? She's worried about travel. She offered a video call where she shows passport on camera + notary attests. Legal says video isn't sufficient for I-9 Section 2.
Kevin B: Ops can do a contactless flow: notary signs, candidate ships passport via trackable courier to our facility, Maria inspects and returns same day with overnight label. But passport shipment is a pain for some folks.
Dana M: Ok Plan A: Lina uses local notary on Monday, we reimburse notary fee. Plan B: if notary unavailable, schedule rep inspection Tue morning at 9am; Kevin will add "hold ship" note to laptop ticket.
Ivy P: I'll coordinate shipping labels with IT and confirm mailing address. Also will add a calendar event for the 9am rep slot and include Zoom as backup for logistics.
Omar H: Compliance reminder: when the rep does Section 2, the rep must fill out the "Authorized Representative" form and include their full name, title, company, and the date. Upload scan to secure folder w/in 24h.
HR Bot: Onboarding checklist: I-9, W-4, direct deposit, emergency contact, and contractor agreement. Link: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/onboarding. Auto-reminder set 72h pre-start.
Dana M: Payroll note: for contractors payroll needs contractor W-9 and the vendor onboarding form before first invoice. Lina was sent vendor form but hasn't returned it. Please ping her.
Ivy P: Sent Lina a short DM with step list and links to W-9 + vendor form. Also asked for passport scan and hotel invoice for Checkr.
Dana M: Update 14:10: Lina replied she booked a notary for Monday 11am and will email the receipt. Also returned the vendor packet and W-9.
Omar H: Great. Once notary is confirmed we'll mark I-9 complete. Remember to call out passport expiration if <6 months remaining.
Dana M: Final: 19:00 Notary confirmed, Checkr cleared after hotel invoice, vendor forms done, IT shipped laptop with "hold for ID" and ops will release after Maria uploads Section 2 scan. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
